## Summary

Describe the consumer problem and the change.

## Validation

- [ ] New functionality includes focused positive, negative, and boundary tests where relevant.
- [ ] Bug fixes include a regression test that fails without the fix.
- [ ] Analyzer/code-fix changes include matching, non-matching, and fix coverage where applicable.
- [ ] Public API baselines are updated when required.
- [ ] Documentation and samples are updated when required.
- [ ] `dotnet format`, release build, and tests pass locally.

## Compatibility

Describe any behavioral, API, package, or analyzer compatibility impact.
